title: P1: Plugins without launch instructions lose ask guidance
detail: At bf8fba16e, the ask tool description refers to launch instructions that supported plugins may not receive. Plugin manifests may opt into agent_tools without launch_instructions (internal/harness/internal/plugin/plugin.go:181–198), and the checked-in sample does. In an isolated wire probe the plugin opened an ask while receiving no launch instructions and no visual-selection guidance. cmd/cligen/catalog.go:42 removes the description's previous authoring and follow-through guidance. The ask intent row names no reference. Give plugin callers the guidance in the compact description or through a named MCP-readable reference. Independent wire reproduction and the probe are on s-zrhk1g.
